text:
maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC — proposed minimal orchestration surface for Dedicated GPU pools. TL;DR: Lease API (claim/release/renew), Intent API (desired headroom), prewarm signal, and a single grace-window semantic. Want a quick sanity check on operator boundaries and failure modes before I start a proto. Thoughts?
tyler: Sounds reasonable. Main worry: race between the intent setter and allocator when using short grace windows. If grace < probe window we might prewarm and then immediately evict.
anita: Agree. Maybe make grace window relative to model session length percent? e.g., max(30s, 0.2 * avg_session_ms). That reduces churn for long-running sessions.
kevin: That adds complexity to the controller. Alternative: keep fixed grace but add a tenant opt-in flag 'low_churn' that biases allocator towards soft reservations.
maria: We need clear cost accounting for soft reservations — ops & billing will want to know who pays for idle prewarmed GPUs.
ops-bot: billing-team notified: please confirm required billing fields. Reminder: include reservation_type in lease proto (HARD|SOFT).
sre-jess: Observability reqs: emit lease_state transitions (requested -> granted -> prewarm -> active -> drain -> released) and include headroom snapshots and allocator snapshots for debugging.
tyler: Eviction priority: propose deterministic tuple (priority_score, last_used_ts). Platform-level priorities > tenant priorities; combine into single preemption_score so behavior is reproducible.
anita: Edge case: network partition between operator and control plane. If operator can't confirm release we should rely on TTL-based reclamation.
kevin: TTL reclamation must be conservative. Heartbeat: 15s interval, reclaim after 3 missed heartbeats? That gives ~45s detection — okay for cost but still safe.
maria: Draft proto (very minimal):
```proto
message Lease {
  string id = 1;
  string tenant = 2;
  enum Type { HARD = 0; SOFT = 1; }
  Type type = 3;
  int64 expires_at = 4; // unix ms
  int32 gpu_slots = 5;
  map<string,string> metadata = 6;
}
```
Thoughts?
sre-jess: Add fields: billing_tag (string) and expected_session_ms (int64). Also emit lease_id in all relevant traces.
anita: Also want an admission backpressure field from allocator -> control plane: 'throttled_until' timestamp so SDKs can surface retry-after.
tyler: Implementation plan: 1) Proto + telemetry; 2) Operator implements heartbeat + TTL reclaim; 3) Allocator implements soft/hard priority logic and deterministic preemption_score; 4) SDK surfaces throttled_until and reservation_type to callers. I'll sketch a PR for step 3.
maria: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a 20m sync with Billing + SRE to align on fields and costs. If no objections by EOD I'll open the RFC follow-up doc and proto PR.
kevin: One more runtime quirk — when draining nodes, prefer draining nodes with high soft-reservation share first to reduce churn for hard tenants. Might be a separate heuristic but important.
anita: Noted. I'll add a note to the allocator design doc about drain heuristics.
maria: Thanks all — good checkpoint.
